page0.text:
"I'm still taking you home. I'm not leaving without you."
There's nothing to consider.
Right now, this is the only choice that exists.

page1.text:
...
Illya doesn't say anything. She gazes at me with an absent expression.
I take her defenseless hand.
"Let's go, Illya. We should go home before they find us."
I pull her close and start walking. She's small and terribly light.

page2.text:
"I'm amazed. I don't think you'll listen to anything I say."
Illya doesn't resist, tottering along with me.
"I mean it. There's no way this can end well."
She happily clasps my hand in return.
